evals.prompt: Create a service blueprint for opening an investment account, from the website to the first trade, including the back office identity check.
evals.expected_output: A blueprint with stages, customer actions, frontstage, line of visibility, backstage and support systems, failure and wait points, every cell labeled observed or assumed.
expectations: Includes frontstage, backstage and support process lanes
Cells are labeled Observed or Assumed
Identity check wait points and failure points are marked
Pain points link to opportunities with owners
